item.title: NH Education Daily — Hot Off the Press: The Ballot Decisions That Will Reshape NH School Districts
item.description:
A one-hour breaking special, October 13, 2026: Three weeks before November 3, every NH voter faces Question 2 — the HB 1300 school tax cap. Alex and Jordan unpack what the ballot says vs. what RSA 32:5-i actually does, Londonderry's warning of million in cuts, district-by-district impacts from Hudson to Oyster River to Mascenic, the failed court challenges, and what real voters are posting on social media right now — verified posts from both sides. Plus: what a levy cap means for special education's unfunded mandates.

item.title: NH Education Deep Dive — Who's Teaching Special Ed? NH's Staffing Shortage
item.description:
The NH Fiscal Policy Institute's new report projects 1,114 teacher openings a year through 2034, with staffing down 5.7%, the pipeline halved, and teachers earning a third less than comparable professionals. Alex and Jordan unpack what it means for special education — endorsement barriers, the para crisis, the contracting trap, FAPE risk — and what districts can actually do about it.

item.title: NH Education Daily — Special Deep Dive: Understanding School Evaluations, Part 1B — The WIAT-IV
item.description:
Part 1 of a new series on understanding school evaluations — second half of a two-part WIAT-IV special. Alex and Jordan continue: how WIAT-IV scores talk to cognitive testing (the ability-achievement conversation behind pattern-of-strengths-and-weaknesses), how the test looks across ages, handling team disagreements about results, using results in general education classrooms, the eligibility meeting, the four-step interpretive sequence, reading the report page by page, error analysis, an eight-question toolkit for parents and teachers, and rapid-fire FAQs. Next in the series: the WISC-V. Vote on future topics in our listener poll: https://strawpoll.com/xVg718Km6yr

item.title: NH Education Daily — Special Deep Dive: Understanding School Evaluations, Part 1A — The WIAT-IV: What the Test Measures
item.description:
